channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: 1931 quantum prediction confirmed by scientists
item.description: Scientists have created and directly observed unusual quantum states known as Bethe strings, nearly a century after physicist Hans Bethe predicted them.

item.title: Ancient hydrogen signal may shed light on dark energy
item.description: A Canadian radio telescope detected faint hydrogen glow from billions of years ago using its own observations, confirming a long-awaited prediction.

item.title: NASA astronauts return after 100 million miles in space
item.description: NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 astronauts have returned to Earth after 237 days in space, traveling more than 100 million miles and completing over 3,792 orbits.

item.title: Bacteria use a virus's own weapon against it
item.description: Researchers have found a new way bacteria detect viral attacks: a virus-produced enzyme cuts a bacterial sensor protein, triggering self-destruction.
